title: Psalms 121
paragraphs: ¹ I lift my eyes to the hills — where does my help come from? ² My help comes from the LORD, the maker of heaven and earth. ³ He will not let your foot slip; your guardian will not slumber. ⁴ Indeed, the guardian of Israel will neither slumber nor sleep. ⁵ The LORD is your guardian; the LORD is your shade at your right hand.

⁶ The sun will not harm you by day, nor the moon by night. ⁷ The LORD will keep you from all harm — he will guard your life. ⁸ The LORD will watch over your coming and going, both now and forevermore.
